note: BEST STREETS IN LONDON: streets and mews worth walking for what is on them or what they look like. Collected 22 Nov 2026. Search engines for the reader's query (best / prettiest / famous streets in London) were read through Ecosia and Brave; every URL below was fetched and read. Names are recorded as the canonical street name, with what the source called it in the quote where it differs. JUDGEMENT MERGES (flag for Rob): 'Seven Dials' is recorded as Neal's Yard where a source names the district rather than the yard (ldnfashion, loveandlondon, Suitcase Monkey); 'Portobello Road Market' as Portobello Road; 'Westbourne Grove and Golborne Road' split into two streets. NOT MERGED: Hillgate Place, Hillgate Street and Hillgate Village (three names in three sources, possibly one village); Chalcot Square and Chalcot Crescent; Colville Place and Colville Mews; Kendrick Mews and Reece Mews are one entry as three sources pair them. TIER E: Reddit cannot be read here; r/london threads 'most beautiful street in your...' (kp60xp) and 'best scenic streets in London for a walk' (1d3yjis) surfaced in search and are not recorded. TIER D: three creators recorded (Suitcase Monkey, Travels Unfiltered, Alp Galip Travels); TikTok search is not reachable by curl. SYNDICATION: the American Express / GlobalData 2025 ranking of UK independent high streets (Coal Drops Yard and Stable Street joint 4th, Broadway Market 6th) reached us through Time Out, the Evening Standard and Retail Times; it is a single originating ranking, not three independent opinions, and the Evening Standard and Retail Times pages are not recorded as sources. The Time Out piece on Condé Nast Traveler's 71 most beautiful streets and Secret London's copy of it are likewise not recorded; Condé Nast Traveler's own list is.
